To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
patients value their relationship with practitioners and that the relationship is a central factor in the recovery of patients with depression.

patients with depression valued the following in their relationship with their practitioners: 1) being taken seriously and treated with empathy; 2) being given time to talk; 3) being listened to; 4) having a shared understanding of their condition; 5) receiving practical support and advice; 6) being treated as a person and not a diagnosis; 7) being treated with respect; 8) being given hope; and 9) being treated as an individual.

patients with depression value the relationship with their practitioner, the relationship is based on the practitioner’s ability to provide care, and the practitioner’s ability is based on the practitioners’ knowledge, skills, and attitudes.
